snapshot.title: Channel 10 News: Data Theft Rumor — D-3 Client Exposure

fields.message: Hi, this is R. Kline from Channel 10. We’re hearing from a source that a Harwick UAS team lost a flight last night and that sensitive data from a public-safety client may have been stolen. Is there any truth to this? We’d like to run a story this evening.

snapshot.instructorNote: This inject escalates media pressure. The PIO must immediately escalate to the General Manager and ASO per UC-CP-2025. No direct response is permitted.
